source: 727 Arrival
target: 727 Adventus

source: As Franca prepared the ritual, she considered her options and said to Lumian, “The Overseer’s mirror coordinates are indescribable and can only be procured through mystical means.
target: Dum Franca ritum parabat, optiones suas consideravit et Lumiano dixit: “Coordinates speculi praefectoris indescribibiles sunt et solum per vias mysticas comparari possunt.

source: The Magic Mirror Spirit Channeling Spell isn’t capable of that.
target: Incantatio Spiritus Canalizationis Speculi Magici non id efficit.

source: I intend to use standard spirit channeling instead.”
target: Intendo spiritum canalizationem ordinariam potius uti.”

source: While the Magic Mirror Spirit Channeling Spell she had developed greatly extended the duration of the channeling and the number of questions the spirit would respond to, it was constrained by relying on the mirror as a medium, forfeiting the chance for other types of interaction.
target: Dum incantatio Spiritus Canalizationis Speculi Magici, quam evolverat, diuturnitatem canalizationis atque numerum quaestionum quibus spiritus responderet multum extendit, restricta est eo quod speculum tam medium adhiberet, ita facultatem aliorum modorum interactionis amittens.

source: “Regular spirit channeling drastically restricts the intel we can gather…”
target: “Canalizatio spiritus ordinaria valde restringit notitiam quam colligere possumus…”

source: Lumian thought briefly and said, “For the first question, we should have him provide the coordinates of the Overseer’s mirror.
target: Lumian brevi cogitavit et dixit: “Pro prima quaestione, eum oportet ut coordinates speculi praefectoris praebeat.

source: Second, ask about the whereabouts of the classic silver mirror utilized for the ritual and leader communication.
target: Secundo, quaere unde sit speculum argenteum classicum, quod ad ritum et ad communicationem cum duce adhibetur.

source: Third, inquire about the identities and locations of the Mirror People in contact with him, ranked by importance.”
target: Tertio, interroga de identitatibus et locis Populi Speculorum, qui cum eo sunt in contactu, secundum momentum ordinatos.”

source: Once the third question was answered, the spirit channeling ritual would come to its natural conclusion.
target: Cum tertia quaestio respondita fuerit, ritus canalizationis spiritus ad finem suum naturalem perveniet.

source: Lumian suspected Moran Avigny might not have time to “introduce” every Mirror Person under his command.
target: Lumian suspicabatur Moran Avigny tempus non habere ut omnes Populos Speculorum sub imperio suo introducere valeat.

source: Hence, he asked for them to be prioritized based on the criticality of their role and responsibilities.
target: Ergo posuit ut hi secundum momentum muneris et officiorum suorum praeferantur.

source: “A classic silver mirror?”
target: “Speculum argenteum classicum?”

source: Franca asked, puzzled.
target: Franca quaesivit, perplexa.

source: “Yes, Moran Avigny has a mirror akin to the classic silver one you used to own.
target: “Ita, Moran Avigny speculum habet simile speculo argenteo classico, quod olim possidebas.

source: It’s vital for communicating with Mirror Roselle,”
target: Id est vitale ad communicationem cum Speculo Rosella,”

source: Lumian explained succinctly.
target: Lumian breviter explanavit.

source: While speaking, he crouched and rummaged through Moran Avigny’s pockets.
target: Dum loquebatur, se inclinavit et in sinibus Moran Avigny quaesivit.

source: Unfortunately, the Minister of Industry carried only a handful of large bills and some loose change totaling 3,212 verl d’or.
target: Infeliciter, Minister Industria solum paucas notas magnas et aliquam pecuniam levem, summa 3,212 verl d’or, gerebat.

source: Besides the money, there was an elegant golden mechanical pocket watch, a meticulously embroidered handkerchief, and a wallet crafted by a private designer and artisan.
target: Praeter pecuniam, erat horologium mechanicum aureum elegans, sudarium diligentissime ex contextum, et marsupium a privato designatore et artifici confectum.

source: But not a single item imbued with Beyonder powers!
target: Sed nullum quidem obiectum viribus Beyonder imbuitum erat!

source: Lumian couldn’t resist mimicking Franca’s inner thought: “Poor slob!”
target: Lumian non potuit resistite imitare interiorem Francae cogitationem: “Pauper spurcus!”

source: He realized that as the sitting Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny was under the watchful eye of official Beyonders.
target: Animadvertit, ut minister industriae sedens, Moran Avigny sub vigilanti oculo Beyonder officialium esset.

source: He was unlikely to carry mystical items, Beyonder weapons, or anything that might reveal his abnormality.
target: Minime verisimile erat eum portare res mysticas, arma Beyonder, aut quidquid eius anomaliam revelare posset.

source: As a Sequence 5 Disciplinary Paladin of the Judgment pathway, disclosing this to the two Churches would raise difficult questions about how he obtained the potion formula and Beyonder characteristics at that level.
target: Ut Paladinus Disciplinarius Sequenciae 5 viae Iudicii, hoc divulgare ad duas Ecclesias quaestiones arduas excitaret de modis quibus potionis formula et proprietates Beyonder in illo gradu obtinerentur.

source: When signing the contract, he would at most acknowledge being a Beyonder of a related pathway without specifying the Sequence.
target: Contractum subsignando, maxime confitebatur se Beyonder esse ad viam cognatam, nec Sequenciam designare.

source: This cost him the chance to procure items openly, forcing him to rely on Brokers—something official Beyonders couldn’t be privy to.
target: Hoc ei impedivit occasionem item aperte comparandi, cogens eum in Brokeris confidere—rem, quam Beyonder officiales nescire poterant.

source: Moran Avigny didn’t require the Overseer’s assistance with the Under the Table deal to access mystical items, as Mirror People could transfer objects through mirrors.
target: Moran Avigny auxilia Praefectoris in pacto “Sub Mensa” ad res mysticas accedendas non requirebat, quoniam Populi Speculorum res per specula transferre poterant.

source: If he genuinely needed an item for a specific purpose, he could reach out to his mirror world associates and have them “send” it over, returning it promptly after use.
target: Si ad aliquam rem specialem vere indigeret, possit ad socios sui ex mundo speculari recurrere et eos iubere ut eam “mitterent”, eam celeriter post usum reddens.

source: Lumian sighed, pocketed the cash, watch, and other belongings, and rose to his feet.
target: Lumian suspiravit, pecuniam, horologium et cetera in sacculis recondidit, atque surrexit.

source: With Franca’s spirit channeling preparations complete, Lumian turned to Jenna, still composing her letter, and asked, “You shot without hesitation earlier.
target: Cum praeparationes canalizationis spiritus Francae confecta essent, Lumian ad Jennam, quae epistolam scribere continuabat, se convertebat atque rogavit: “Prius sine dubitatione iaculata es.

source: Did it weigh on you at all?
target: Numquid tibi gravuit?

source: This wasn’t a battle.
target: Hoc non erat proelium.

source: We’d been engaged in friendly conversation with Moran Avigny for a while now.
target: Iam diuturno tempore colloquium amicale cum Moran Avigny habuimus.

source: I even started to feel like we were becoming friends.”
target: Etiam coepi sentire quasi amicos fiamus.”

source: Jenna glanced up at Lumian while writing on a protruding rock of the cave wall.
target: Jenna ad Lumian intuita est dum in saxo eminenti parietis speluncae scribebat.

source: She laughed softly.
target: Submissa risit.

source: “Worried I’ll bottle up my emotional turmoil and cause issues down the line?
target: “Pertimesne ne tumultus affectuum meorum coartus maneat et difficultates in posterum oriantur?

source: Planning to play psychiatrist and offer me counseling?”
target: Cogitans te quasi psychiatrem agere atque mihi consilium offerre?”

source: Anthony Reid, who had been observing silently, living up to his role as a Spectator, scratched his nose self-consciously.
target: Anthony Reid, qui silentio observabat et muneri Spectatoris incumbebat, nasum suum cum timore conscientiae arrupit.

source: That seemed to be his job.
target: Id videtur esse officium eius.

source: However, he could discern that Jenna and Franca were not in need of counseling.
target: Attamen animadvertit Jennam et Francam consilio non egere.

source: Lumian didn’t tackle Jenna’s question head-on.
target: Lumian quaestionem Jennae directe non responsit.

source: With a smile, he remarked, “You haven’t taken many lives yourself.”
target: Sub risu, ille dixit: “Non tot vitas abstulisti.”

source: “Had we not pulled the trigger, would you have taken action?
target: “An, nisi ictum deesset, ageresne?

source: Despite feeling you had befriended Moran Avigny, I think you wouldn’t have flinched at blowing his head off,”
target: Quamquam existimabas te cum Moran Avigny amicam esse relationem, puto te non titubavisse ad eius caput explodendum,”

source: Jenna retorted, a smile playing on her lips.
target: Jenna respondit, subrisu labiis ornata.

source: Lumian let out a derisive snort.
target: Lumian irridens sputum edidit.

source: “I’m not like you.
target: “Non similis sum tibi.

source: I’ve killed more people than I can count.”
target: Multos homines interfeci, quos numerare non possum.”

source: Jenna met his gaze again.
target: Jenna iterum eius aspectum convenit.

source: “Moran Avigny admitted to his crimes.
target: “Moran Avigny crimina sua agnovit.

source: He lured the real Moran Avigny into the mirror, holding him captive before ruthlessly ending his life.
target: Eum, verum Moran Avigny, in speculum allicit, eum captivum retinens antequam vitam eius crudelis modo finiret.

source: I felt no qualms about carrying out the execution of a guilty man.”
target: Nullas remoras sensitus sum in supplicio viri reum.

source: “You’ve changed…”
target: “Mutata es…”

source: Lumian let out an exaggerated sigh and quipped, “Once upon a time, you depended on the police and authorities to punish the bad guys.”
target: Lumian exsaggeratum suspirium edidit atque iocose inquit: “Olim in vigilum et auctoritatum fidem innixus es ad peccatores punire.”

source: Jenna didn’t have a chance to respond, as Franca had finished her spirit channeling.
target: Jenna occasionem respondendi non habuit, cum Franca canalizationem spiritus perfecisset.

source: In the wavering dark-green candlelight, Moran Avigny’s spirit took shape above his corpse, perceptible to those who had activated their Spirit Vision.
target: In luce viridique obscurae candelarum vacillantis, spiritus Moran Avigny super cadaver eius formam suscepit, ab illis qui Visionem Spiritus excitaverant, perceptibilis.

source: Franca acted swiftly.
target: Franca celeriter egit.

source: Withdrawing the glass-like Mirror Cufflink from her sleeve, she addressed Moran Avigny’s spirit, “Give me the coordinates of the Overseer’s mirror.”
target: Ex manica cufflink speculi vitrei extrahens, ad spiritum Moran Avigny locuta est: “Da mihi coordinates speculi praefectoris.”

source: Moran Avigny’s indistinct, menacing face twisted in anguish.
target: Vultus indeterminus et minax Moran Avigny angore contractus est.

source: But stripped of life, he no longer had the ironclad self-control to resist the commanding pull of the spirit channeling.
target: Sed, vita destituens, non iam habebat rigidae moderationis vires ad vim imperii canalizationis spiritus resistere.

source: He stretched out his right hand, motioning for Franca to hand over the Mirror Cufflink.
target: Manum dexteram protendit, Francae signum dedit ut cufflink speculi tradiret.

source: Anticipating this, Franca passed him the Mirror Cufflink.
target: Prævidens hoc, Franca illi cufflink speculi tradidit.

source: As Moran Avigny’s spirit clutched the cufflink, a shadowy light shimmered across its form, drawn into the glass-like accessory.
target: Dum spiritus Moran Avigny cufflink concepit, lumen umbratile per eius formam micavit, in ornamentum vitreum trahens.

source: Franca exhaled in relief upon the Mirror Cufflink’s return.
target: Franca leviter suspiravit de reditu cufflink speculi.

source: Having achieved the primary objective, it was time to reap further rewards!
target: Prima meta confecta, tempus erat ulteriora praemia colligere!

source: Her mood buoyed, Franca inquired of Moran Avigny with piqued interest, “Is there a functional classic silver mirror in your possession…
target: Animata animo, Franca cum acuto studio a Moran Avigny quesivit: “Habesne speculum argenteum classicum functionalem in tua possessione…

source: Hold on…”
target: Exspecta…”

source: Abruptly realizing this constituted a question, she hastily rephrased.”Where is the classic silver mirror the Overseer used to facilitate communication with your leader?”
target: Subito intellegens hoc quaestionem esse, festinanter redixerat: “Ubi est speculum argenteum classicum, quod praefector ad communicationem cum duce tuo adhibebat?”

source: Lumian had already ascertained Moran Avigny didn’t have it on him.
target: Lumian iam perspexerat Moran Avigny id in se non habere.

source: Moran Avigny’s spirit responded with cold rigidity, “Griffith has it.
target: Spiritus Moran Avigny cum frigida rigiditate respondit: “Griffith id habet.

source: When I require it, I have him deliver it to me through the mirror.”
target: Quando id require, eum iubeo ut per speculum mihi tradat.”

source: Franca’s initial elation quickly gave way to an exasperated curse.
target: Gaudium primum Francae celeriter in exasperatum maledictum conversa est.

source: “Dammit!”
target: “Damnatum!”

source: It dawned on her that she couldn’t extract Griffith’s mirror coordinates from Moran Avigny.
target: Illuc eam pervenit quod coordinates speculi Griffith a Moran Avigny extrahere non posset.

source: The spirit channeling had but one question remaining.
target: Canalizatio spiritus solam quaestionem reliquam habebat.

source: She needed to ask Moran Avigny about the Mirror People serving as their contacts and their true identities.
target: Eam oportebat a Moran Avigny quaerere de Populis Speculorum, qui ut contactus funguntur, et de eorum veris identitatibus.

source: Requesting mirror coordinates was out of the question!
target: Petere coordinates speculi impossibile erat!

source: Lumian and Anthony immediately grasped the reason for Franca’s self-directed frustration, but they were powerless to intervene.
target: Lumian et Anthony statim causam frustrationis a Franca sui intellexerunt, sed intervenire non poterant.

source: Certain questions hinged on preceding answers, and mirror coordinates couldn’t be conveyed through the Magic Mirror Spirit Channeling Spell.
target: Quaedam quaestiones ex praecedentibus responsionibus pendebant, et coordinates speculi per incantationem Spiritus Canalizationis Speculi Magici tradi non poterant.

source: Collecting herself, Franca fixed her gaze on Moran Avigny’s spirit.
target: Se contuliens, Franca oculos suos in spiritum Moran Avigny fixavit.

source: Marshaling her thoughts, she articulated, “Name the Mirror People in contact with you.
target: Cogitationes suas ordinans, dixit: “Nomina Populos Speculorum, qui tecum sunt in contactu.

source: What roles do they play in the real world?
target: Quae munera in mundo reali agunt?

source: Begin with those of the highest rank and responsibility.”
target: Incipe ab iis summi ordinis et officii.

source: Moran Avigny’s ghostly, blurred visage contorted once more.
target: Vultus phantasma et nebulosus Moran Avigny iterum contorquebatur.

source: Despite his resistance, he responded in a clipped tone, “First, there’s Griffith, who serves as my second-in-command.
target: Quamquam repugnans, respondebat concisus: “Primum, Griffith est, qui mihi secundarius imperator fungitur.

source: Originally, he was a key figure in the Moses Ascetic Order.
target: Olim figura praecipua in Ordine Ascetico Mosiensi fuit.

source: With our assistance, he’s steadily elevating his position within the Order.
target: Auxilio nostro, constanter locum suum in Ordine augere conatur.

source: His aspiration is for the secret organization to eventually join the alliance to open Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal…”
target: Eius aspiratio est ut societas arcana tandem ad coniunctionem accedat ad sigillum Quartae Epoch Trier aperiendum…”

source: The Moses Ascetic Order…
target: Ordo Asceticus Mosiensis…

source: The very group that clashed with Element Dawn, headed by the Emperor’s firstborn, Bernadette?
target: Coetus ille, qui cum Elemento Aurora certabat, ducitur a primogenita imperatoris, Bernadette?

source: If memory serves, they primarily consist of Mystery Pryer pathway Beyonders…
target: Si memoria servat, praecipue ex Beyonder in via Mystery Pryer constare vident…

source: I can’t help but wonder if the Research Society has members from either faction.
target: Nescio quin cogitare possim num Societas Investigationis membra ex utraque factione habeat.

source: There must be others like myself with multiple secret society affiliations…
target: Certe alii, sicut ego, cum pluribus nexibus in societatibus arcanis, esse debent…

source: Franca listened intently, not daring to disrupt Moran Avigny’s account.
target: Franca attente auscultavit, non audens narrationem Moran Avigny interrumpere.

source: Moran Avigny proceeded to the second Mirror Person.
target: Moran Avigny ad secundum Populum Speculorum procedit.

source: “Caratanza Tamara, part of our branch’s Tamara family.
target: “Caratanza Tamara, pars familiae Tamara rami nostri.

source: He enlisted in the military and now holds the rank of colonel.
target: Militiae se adiunxit et nunc gradum colonelis obtinet.

source: He legitimized his Beyonder powers by slaying a Loen Kingdom spy, seizing their potion formula and Judgment pathway characteristics…
target: Eius vires Beyonder legitimas fecit, dum speculator Regni Loen interfecit, eorum potionis formulam et proprietates viae Iudicii rapiens…

source: “Palia, a ore scholar originally.
target: “Palia, olim erudita in metallo.

source: She infiltrated the Trier Cave Association to mask our attempts at uncovering a vulnerability in the seal…
target: Infiltravit Societatem Speluncarum Trier, ut conatus nostros ad infirmitatem sigilli detegendam celare posset…

source: “Sport, Trier’s Deputy Commissioner of Police and a member of the police commission.
target: “Sport, vice commissarius vigilum Trier et membrum commissionis vigilum.

source: His original self was purposely corrupted during an operation.
target: Eius forma originalis proposito in operatione corrupta est.

source: Subsequently, Griffith and Caratanza orchestrated an ambush, dragging him into the mirror and allowing the mirror world’s Sport to emerge and assume his place…
target: Postea, Griffith et Caratanza insidias composuerunt, eum in speculum trahebant et Sport, ex mundo speculari, emergere ac locum eius obtinere sinerunt…

source: By this point, Moran Avigny’s spirit had become increasingly insubstantial, on the brink of dissipation.
target: Hac in hora, spiritus Moran Avigny magis magisque insubstantialis factus erat, evanescendi limine.

source: At that instant, Jenna concluded her letter and pivoted to face Lumian.
target: Illo momento, Jenna epistolam finivit et se ad Lumian convertit.

source: “I’ll now summon Madam Judgment’s messenger.”
target: “Nunc advocabo nuntium Dominae Iudicii.”

source: The words had scarcely left her mouth when an ethereal voice, seemingly originating from a great distance, reverberated in the ears of Jenna, Lumian, and the others.
target: Vix verba e ore eius exierant, cum vox aetherea, paene ex longinquo orta, in auribus Jennae, Lumiani, et ceterorum resonabat.

source: “Summoning won’t be necessary.”
target: “Vocatio non erit necessaria.”

source: A shared premonition compelled Lumian, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony to direct their attention to the side of the quarry cave.
target: Communis praemonitio Lumian, Francam, Jennam, et Anthoni coegit ut intentionem suam ad latus fodinarum speluncae converterent.

source: In the chamber’s dim illumination, supplied only by carbide lamps and candles, dazzling starlight coalesced in the void, rapidly tracing the outline of an enchanting door.
target: In obscura camerae luce, solum lumine lampadarum carbidentium et candelarum provisa, stellae fulgida in vacuo coalescebant, celeriter figuram ianuae incantatae delineantes.

source: Noiselessly, the door swung open, revealing an enormous pumpkin carriage drawn by a multitude of gray rats.
target: Sine strepitu, ianua aperiebatur, demonstrans currum cucurbitaceum ingentem a multitudine murum cinereorum tractatum.

source: Three women occupied the carriage’s interior.
target: Tres feminae currus interiori occupant.

source: One was Magician, resplendent in a beige gown with a high collar adorned with golden embroidery.
target: Una erat Maga, in vestimenta beige splendida, cum colla alto aureis ornamentis innixis.

source: Another was Judgment, her shoulder-length flaxen hair complementing her grayish‑white knight’s attire, accented by brown leather armor.
target: Altera erat Iudicium, capillis flavis ad humeros usque, qui vestimentum equitis cinereo-album complementabant, lorica coriacea fusca accentuata.

source: The third woman was clad in a purple dress bearing a cryptic pattern.
target: Tertia femina induta erat vestitu purpureo, cum exemplo arcaico inscripto.

source: A celestial globe and sundry items dangled from her waist, and refined spectacles perched upon her nose.
target: Globus caelestis et varia ex inguine eius pendent, et oculi speculares elegantes in naso eius insident.

source: Clasped in her left hand was a peculiar lamp, its surface golden like a kettle and adorned with enigmatic designs.
target: In manu sinistra tenebatur lampas peculiaris, cuius superficies aurea quasi ollae similis erat et designis enigmaticis ornata.
